hero.title: Cut your import costs by up to
hero.subtitle: Join a cargo pool and share freight costs with other importers. The more volume accumulates, the lower the price per m³ for everyone.

pool.title: Active Pools
pool.subtitle: The reference price is the maximum. Your actual price drops based on how many days you've been in the pool.
pool.referenceNote: Maximum reference price. Actual price varies based on your entry day.

pricing.title: How are savings distributed?
pricing.subtitle: The savings generated by pool volume are dynamically distributed. The longer you've been in the pool, the larger your share of the discount.

howItWorks.title: How does it work?
howItWorks.step1Desc: Select the pool matching your route and sign up. The earlier you join, the bigger your discount.
howItWorks.step2Desc: As more importers join and volume grows, the price per m³ decreases for everyone.
howItWorks.step3Desc: Your final price is calculated based on how many days you've been in the pool. Savings go directly to you, not middlemen.

transparency.title: Full transparency
transparency.desc: We publish the maximum reference price. Each client's actual price varies based on their pool entry day, and is always less than or equal to the reference price. You never pay more than what you see.
transparency.point1: The reference price is the ceiling, not the actual price
transparency.point2: The earlier you join, the bigger your savings
transparency.point3: Our commission is deducted from savings generated, not from the base price
